optimized_sql:
SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
FROM (
    SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM (
        SELECT it.i_category, it.i_class, it.i_brand, it.i_product_name,
               fs.d_year, fs.d_qoy, fs.d_moy, st.s_store_id,
               SUM(fs.sumsales) AS sumsales
        FROM (
            SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, dd.d_year, dd.d_qoy, dd.d_moy,
                   SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
            FROM store_sales ss
            JOIN date_dim dd
              ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
             AND dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
            GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, dd.d_year, dd.d_qoy, dd.d_moy
        ) fs
        JOIN item it ON fs.ss_item_sk = it.i_item_sk
        JOIN store st ON fs.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
        GROUP BY ROLLUP(
            it.i_category,
            it.i_class,
            it.i_brand,
            it.i_product_name,
            fs.d_year,
            fs.d_qoy,
            fs.d_moy,
            st.s_store_id
        )
    ) dw1
) dw2
WHERE rk <= 100
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
